name: capella
label: Capella (alpha Aur Aa + Ab, K0 III + G1 III, 104 d)
sources: Johnson 1966 / Ducati 2002: V 0.08, H -1.72, K -1.78 (system); SIMBAD coordinates
notes: Angular diameters 8.5 and 6.2 mas at 13.16 pc; separation up to 56 mas, fringe period lambda/rho = 5.7 m at 1550 nm (3.3 m at 900 nm) against the ISI's 1.65 m pupils: pupil smearing on.
The two giants are nearly equal in the near-IR (Delta mag ~0 at 700 nm), so the fringe contrast is high; both are resolved beyond ~40 m (first nulls 46 and 63 m at 1550 nm).
assumptions: node_pa_deg sense against hbtsim's convention (checked for beta Aur with Jonak et al.; not yet for Capella)
